title: Cancer: current or history, and metastases
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's cancer as documented at this visit.
note:
Chief Complaint: Follow-up for history of colon cancer.

HPI: Pt is a 71 y.o. female presenting for routine follow-up of history of colon carcinoma. Primary tumor was surgically removed and treated several years ago. Pt reports feeling well with no new symptoms. Treatment is complete. No new concerns voiced today.

Medication List: Multivitamin daily.

Exam: Pt appears well-developed, well-nourished, and in no acute distress. Alert and oriented x3. Skin is warm and dry. Heart sounds regular and RRR. Lungs clear to auscultation. Abdomen soft, non-tender, non-distended. WNL.

Assessment: 1. History of colon cancer. Surgical intervention and systemic treatment completed years ago. Clinical status stable. No evidence of local recurrence. No evidence of disease at the primary site or other locations.

Plan: Continue surveillance as scheduled. No active treatment directed at the primary site at this time. Pt to return for routine follow-up.

Electronically signed, H. Tanaka, PA-C, 05/14/2026
explanations: The colon cancer was excised or eradicated, no treatment is directed to it and there is no evidence of it: personal history Z85.038 (no HCC). Any metastasis is still coded as a current secondary malignancy.

distractors.why: Treatment ended and there is no evidence of the primary: code personal history (Z85), not active cancer.
